basic_details.job_title: Cochin Port Authority Master Tugs Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Port Authority (CoPA), Willingdon Island, Kerala, is filling 2 posts of Master Tugs (Class – I). Both posts are unreserved (UR) and are filled on a regular basis by direct recruitment. The pay scale is Rs. 50000-160000, and candidates need a Certificate of Competency as Master (NCV) or Mate of a foreign going ship. Applications are accepted only through the online application portal. Online registration and fee payment run from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply through the online application portal linked on the Cochin Port careers page (www.cochinport.gov.in/careers). The notice says this is the only valid method and that no other application mode will be accepted. Documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on must be submitted with the online application.
Open the online application portal from the Cochin Port careers page and complete the basic registration. Note the "Application reference No." you receive.

Go to State Bank Collect (onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect), click "Govt. Departments" and select "Cochin Port Trust" from the dropdown. You can also use the direct payment link in the "Payment details" window of the application portal.
In the payment category, select the post you are applying for. Enter your Application reference No., any remarks and the mandatory details.
Tick the box agreeing to the Terms and Conditions and enter the Captcha.
Pay the application processing fee of Rs.400/- by Net banking, card payment or another mode offered. You must also bear any extra payment gateway or bank charges.
Download the payment receipt and upload it in the "Payment details" window of the application portal.
Fill in all the necessary details, upload the documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on, and make the final submission.

No changes or modifications are allowed after submission. Each candidate may submit only one complete application, and submitting more than one will lead to rejection of all of them. Candidates who apply on the last date may not get troubleshooting help or technical support by email or phone after 1600 hrs on 27 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About CoPA
content_sections.text: Cochin Port Authority (CoPA) is the port authority at Willingdon Island, Kerala State, India, PIN 682 009. CoPA describes this recruitment as a regular, direct-recruitment appointment, and the notice is signed by the Sr. Dy. Secretary.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 35 years. Employees of Major Port Authorities of India who hold the prescribed qualification may also apply, but for them the upper age limit must not exceed fifty five years. The crucial date for determining the eligibility is 27 November 2026. Employees working in Central / State Government, Semi-Govt. or Autonomous Bodies, or CPSEs are advised to get approval from their competent authority before they apply. They must submit a No Objection Certificate if they are selected or shortlisted. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. rows.essential_qualification_experience: Certificate of Competency as Master (NCV) or Mate of a foreign going ship issued under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 or an equivalent qualification recognized by Ministry of Shipping, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Master Tugs (Class – I) is a regular post filled by direct recruitment, in the pay scale of Rs. 50000-160000. On top of the basic pay, other allowances and benefits are admissible as per rules. These include VDA, accommodation/HRA, a Cafeteria Allowance at 35% of Basic Pay, and encashment of Earned Leave.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I)
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply through the online application portal linked on the Cochin Port careers page (www.cochinport.gov.in/careers). The notice says this is the only valid method and that no other application mode will be accepted. Documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on must be submitted with the online application. Open the online application portal from the Cochin Port careers page and complete the basic registration. Note the "Application reference No." you receive. Go to State Bank Collect (onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect), click "Govt. Departments" and select "Cochin Port Trust" from the dropdown. You can also use the direct payment link in the "Payment details" window of the application portal. In the payment category, select the post you are applying for. Enter your Application reference No., any remarks and the mandatory details. Tick the box agreeing to the Terms and Conditions and enter the Captcha. Pay the application processing fee of Rs.400/- by Net banking, card payment or another mode offered. You must also bear any extra payment gateway or bank charges. Download the payment receipt and upload it in the "Payment details" window of the application portal. Fill in all the necessary details, upload the documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on, and make the final submission. No changes or modifications are allowed after submission. Each candidate may submit only one complete application, and submitting more than one will lead to rejection of all of them. Candidates who apply on the last date may not get troubleshooting help or technical support by email or phone after 1600 hrs on 27 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Cochin Port Authority reserves the right to shortlist candidates and to limit the number called for a written test and/or personal interview. This shortlisting may be done on the basis of qualification and experience, using appropriate selection criteria. CoPA may also change the selection process. Submitting an application does not by itself give a candidate the right to be considered for selection. Candidature is purely provisional. It depends on verification of original certificates proving age and essential qualifications, on medical fitness and other checks, and on meeting the notified eligibility requirements. All official communication will be sent to the email ID given in the online application, so candidates should regularly check the official website and their registered email for updates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CoPA Recruitment 2026 for Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Master Tugs (Class – I), and both are unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: Online registration and fee payment close on 27 November 2026. Technical support may not be available after 1600 hrs on that day.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: You need a Certificate of Competency as Master (NCV) or Mate of a foreign going ship, issued under the Merchant Shipping Act, 1958. An equivalent qualification recognized by the Ministry of Shipping, Government of India is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, and eligibility is determined as on 27 November 2026. For employees of Major Port Authorities of India with the prescribed qualification, the upper age limit must not exceed 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 50000-160000. Allowances such as VDA, accommodation/HRA, a Cafeteria Allowance at 35% of Basic Pay and encashment of Earned Leave are admissible as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: The application processing fee is Rs.400/-, paid through State Bank Collect. Candidates must also bear any payment gateway or bank charges.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online application portal linked on www.cochinport.gov.in/careers. Pay the fee, upload the payment receipt in the "Payment details" window, and then make the final submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I)?
faq.answer: CoPA may shortlist candidates on the basis of qualification and experience for a written test and/or personal interview. Selection also depends on verification of original certificates and medical fitness.

faq.question: Q9. Is CoPA Master Tugs (Class – I) a permanent post?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointment is on a regular basis by direct recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Can I submit more than one application?
faq.answer: No. Each candidate must submit only one complete application, and submitting more than one will lead to rejection of all of them.
